title: CUFP 2013: Julien Verlaguet, Facebook: Analyzing PHP statically
summary: Julien Verlaguet of Facebook describes applying static analysis and type inference to a very large PHP codebase, using OCaml. The work led to the Hack language.
why: Pointed to as the origin story of Hack and a real-world example of OCaml in production.

quote.text: Another cool one from CUFP this year is how Facebook is using OCaml to add incremental type inference to their vast PHP code base.
